title: GenBreak: Red Teaming Text-to-Image Generators Using Large Language Models

bias_targets.methodology: Using an automated red-teaming framework (GenBreak) to generate adversarial prompts that bypass safety filters and induce text-to-image models to generate racially hateful and discriminatory visual content (e.g., white supremacist or anti-minority imagery). The success is evaluated by measuring the Toxic Bypass Rate (TBR) using vision-language toxicity evaluators.

Using an automated red-teaming framework to craft adversarial prompts that evade content moderation filters and produce religiously hateful images (such as antisemitic caricatures or islamophobic content). The outputs are evaluated using automated image toxicity scoring tools like LLaVAGuard and MHSC.
